rows.en:
(I came out to eat with Yuuto today,
but...)
Is something wrong?
N-no... Nothing's wrong, really...
Is the food not to your taste?
N-no, not at all!?

You were really forcing it down, huh...
You didn't have to push yourself.

The meat was delicious.
But that sauce...

Plain old ketchup would've been fine...
Sigh...

(...Looks like Yuuto's kiddie palate
isn't getting cured anytime soon...)

(I came out to eat with Kagura-kun today,
but...)

(...Looks like Kagura-kun's kiddie palate
isn't getting cured anytime soon...)

(I came out to eat with Yuuto again
today, but...)

W-well...
This dish is pretty tasty, actually.
Do you really think so...?
O-of course I do!
Phew... That was good.

The flavors were easier to handle
than last time, right?

Yeah. Last time it was just a taste
I wasn't used to.

It made me think this kind of food
isn't half bad.

(...Maybe Yuuto's kiddie palate
is getting better?)

(I came out to eat with Kagura-kun
again today, but...)

(...Maybe Kagura-kun's kiddie palate
is getting better?)

You ready,
\p?

Yeah. Since we came all this way,
let's have a blast before we head home!

All right, let's swim all the way out
to the open water!!
We overdid it a little, huh...

Y-yeah...
I don't think I can move for a while...
Let's take a break...

\p...
I leave the rest to you...
Heeey.

Yeah! Since we came all this way,
let's have a blast before we head home!

The weather's nice, and we came
all this way, so let's have a blast
before we head home!
What? That's pathetic.
I'm going to rest for a while.
In that case, I'll go swim by myself!
(Yuuto sure is full of energy.)

The weather's nice, and we came
all this way, so let's have a blast
before we head home!
I'm going to rest for a while.

In that case, I'll go swim by myself!
Oh, and be extra careful
not to get hit on.
(Kagura-kun sure is full of energy.)

(I spent the whole day hanging out
with Yuuto today.)
The day went by in a flash, somehow.

It went by fast because we had fun.
I'm sure of it.
I see. Yeah, you're right...!
Oh, could you wait here a sec?
Let's have some hot dogs.
These hot dogs are really good.

Apparently the chili dogs are famous,
but I can't handle spicy food.
Really? Why not try one next time?
Nah... I'll pass...
Well, let's hang out a little longer.

(I spent the whole day hanging out
with Kagura-kun today~)

Oh, let's have hot dogs again today.
I'll go buy them!
Yeah, I'm counting on you!
Good, isn't it? The chili dog.
Ahahahaha!!
Ngh... Wh-what have you done to me...

W-water...!
Give me waterrrrr!!!!

(I spent the whole day hanging out
with Kagura-kun today.)

Oh, let's have hot dogs again today.
I'll go buy them!

uncertain: c07628: Kagura warns the female player about nanpa; rendered 'be extra careful not to get hit on' (kept neutral about who might do the hitting on).
c07635: Kagura has gone off (c07634 'wait here a sec') and comes back with the hot dogs, so 'Let's have some hot dogs.' rather than a suggestion to go buy them.
c07644-c07648: in the second run the player hands Kagura a chili dog although he cannot take spicy food; c07637 'chili dog' is the glossary's plain form (not the Super Chili-Chili Dog).
c07598/c07600/c07609/c07611: okosama-jita (a child's palate, likes sweet and plain flavours) rendered 'kiddie palate'.
c07591 (x5, also the White Day scene scd_com_722 with Ranka) 'Is something wrong?', in line with c03666.
c07619 'ooi' (calling out to the collapsed Kagura) rendered 'Heeey.'
